input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set in the deployment environment, so password reset (and rollup/export) links are built from that fallback instead of the real public host. This matches the reporter's symptom of reset emails linking to localhost. Fix by ensuring `PUBLIC_URL` is always set in production config, or by failing loudly / using a proper configured base URL instead of a localhost default.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from BASE_URL. If PUBLIC_URL isn't set correctly in the production environment, this silently produces localhost links in password reset emails, which matches the reported behavior.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set to the correct production URL in the deployment/environment configuration, and consider making the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) when PUBLIC_URL is missing in a non-development environment, rather than silently defaulting to localhost. This would prevent the bug from recurring undetected after future releases.
